notes: National-level shard. Providers here are available to all US veterans regardless of location. State and regional shards take precedence — this shard loads last as the universal fallback.
expansion_note: Add state shards under DATA/US/{STATE}.json. National providers only belong here if they operate in every state or provide virtual/phone services nationwide.

providers.name: National Veterans Legal Services Program (NVLSP)
providers.notes: Free legal representation for veterans on VA benefits claims including CAVC appeals. National reach. Apply online.

providers.name: Disabled American Veterans (DAV) — National
providers.notes: National VSO with chapters in every state. Free VA claims assistance. Transportation program (VANTAP). Find your chapter at dav.org/find-a-chapter.

providers.name: Veterans of Foreign Wars (VFW) — National
providers.notes: National VSO. Free claims assistance through VFW National Veterans Service. Unmet Needs emergency financial program. Find posts at vfw.org.

providers.name: American Legion — National
providers.notes: National VSO. Free claims assistance. Scholarship programs. Find posts at legion.org.

providers.name: National Coalition for Homeless Veterans (NCHV)
providers.notes: National network of veteran homelessness service providers. Referral hub and advocacy. SSVF grantee coordination.

providers.name: Swords to Plowshares
providers.notes: Veterans legal services. Discharge upgrade expertise. Strong national reputation for MST and OTH discharge cases. Primarily West Coast but legal resources available nationally.

providers.name: Final Salute Inc.
providers.notes: Safe, stable housing for women veterans and their children. National reach. Virtual intake.

providers.name: Service Women's Action Network (SWAN)
providers.notes: National advocacy and peer support for women who served. MST legal resources and discharge upgrade support.
